title: FLUX 3 adds layout-controlled image generation and targeted editing
friendlyTitle: FLUX 3 gives people more control over AI-made images
summary: Black Forest Labs has introduced FLUX 3 Image with bounding-box layout controls, stronger prompt following and multi-region edits that aim to preserve untouched parts of an image. Users can draw boxes directly or let a language model propose an editable composition.
friendlySummary: You can place parts of an image with boxes and change selected areas without rebuilding the whole picture.
whyItMatters: Precise placement makes image generation more useful for design work that needs repeatable layouts rather than attractive surprises. Designers can iterate on individual elements while keeping the rest of a composition stable.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make AI image tools more practical for posters, product layouts and other designs where each element needs a clear place.
